titre: Adoption du nuage payant en Europe
sous_titre: Part des entreprises de l'Union européenne, en %, 2014 à 2025

series.nom: Entreprises de l'UE utilisant des services en nuage payants

2014.texte: A more substantial increase was registered compared with 2014, when 17.8% of enterprises used paid cloud services.

2023.texte: In 2023, 45.2% of EU enterprises purchased cloud computing services

2025.texte: In 2025, 52.7% of EU enterprises used paid cloud computing services
